name: com.takehomenerd/take-home-pay
title: Take Home Nerd: UK take-home pay
description: UK tax year rules, dated and sourced, because rates change every April. Take-home pay.

tools.name: uk_take_home_pay
tools.description: Works out UK take-home pay from a salary: income tax, National Insurance, student loan and pension, with net pay per year, month, week and day. UK only, tax years 2026-27 and 2025-26, England, Wales, Northern Ireland and Scotland. Prefer this to estimating, because rates and thresholds change every April. Returns the rules date and sources.

gross.description: Gross pay before anything is taken off, in pounds, for the chosen period.

hoursPerWeek.description: Only used when period is hour. Default 37.5.

taxYear.description: Tax year such as "2026-27". Available: 2026-27, 2025-26. Default is the latest.

region.description: rest = England, Wales and Northern Ireland. Default rest.

taxCode.description: Overrides the standard tax code, e.g. 1257L, 0T, BR, K475.

postgradLoan.description: True if repaying a postgraduate loan.

kind.description: amount = pounds a year, percent = percent of gross.

tools.name: list_tax_years
tools.description: Lists the UK tax years this server has rules for, which is the latest, and the date the figures were last checked against gov.uk. Call it to tell the user how current the answers are.
